info.name: Shield
info.summary: Manage your Proxmox Mail Gateway spam & virus quarantine directly from Nextcloud.
info.description:
Souvera Shield is the Nextcloud user interface for **Proxmox Mail Gateway (PMG)**.
It lets every user manage their own:
- **Spam quarantine** – preview, release, delete (incl. bulk & CSV export) - **File & virus quarantine** – review attachments and infected mails (optional) - **Personal whitelist / blacklist** – maintain trusted and blocked senders - **Unified search** – find quarantine messages through the Nextcloud Ctrl+K palette - **Dashboard widget** – see the latest quarantined mails on the Nextcloud home - **Bell notifications** – periodic background job raises a notification when new mails arrive - **Audit log** – every release / delete is recorded for administrators
Global settings (desktop notifications, daily summary, min spam score) are managed centrally through the **Souvera Central** app; Shield reads them at runtime and does not store its own copy.
The app talks to PMG through Nextcloud's HTTP client; the PMG password is **encrypted at rest** via the Nextcloud ICrypto secret. It is fully integrated with Nextcloud's app layout and theming (NC 32–34) – no custom skin required.
